crossRefs.note: Then one possessed by a demon, blind and mute, was brought to him and he healed him, so that the blind and mute man…
All the multitudes were amazed, and said, “Can this be the son of David?”
One of the multitude answered, “Teacher, I brought to you my son, who has a mute spirit;
He was casting out a demon, and it was mute. When the demon had gone out, the mute man spoke; and the multitudes…

translations.web: As they went out, behold, a mute man who was demon possessed was brought to him.
translations.bsb: As they were leaving, a demon-possessed man who was mute was brought to Jesus.
translations.kjv: As they went out, behold, they brought to him a dumb man possessed with a devil.
translations.asv: And as they went forth, behold, there was brought to him a dumb man possessed with a demon.
